CustomField.description: The exact structured tag the AI must output if it detects this condition, parsed deterministically by Apex rather than inferred from prose.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Define a unique tag the AI should emit if it detects this condition, such as VIOLATION_BULK_EXPORT_ATTEMPT. Apex looks for this exact tag in the response — the AI's free-text explanation is never trusted directly. Must be unique across all rules.
CustomField.label: Signal Tag
